statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Nasdaq futures are closed for the weekend, so no live one-way NQ path is available; elevated yields, oil and geopolitical risk remain Stress drivers.
recommendation: Weekend closure removes live price-path confirmation. Current Tail remains below the block threshold; the next meaningful structure check is the Sunday futures reopen.
headline: Weekend closure leaves Tail low while macro and geopolitical Stress remains extreme
body: Friday's 162,000 payroll gain pushed Treasury yields and rate-hike expectations higher, but equities were two-sided: the Nasdaq fell 0.29% while semiconductors gained 3.4%. Brent ended the week at $92.68 amid constrained Hormuz traffic. With CME NQ closed, these are reopening-risk inputs rather than current persistent-path evidence.
